listenings.text: Good morning, and welcome to the plant. Please take a safety card at the entrance. The meeting room is on the first floor, next to the coffee machine. There is an elevator behind you, on the left. Your badge is in the blue box on the table. If you go to the production area, there are safety glasses at the door. Thank you.

Attention, please. This is a safety announcement. There is a test of the alarm today, at three in the afternoon. It is only a test. During the test there is no production in the plant. Please stay at your desk, or outside the yellow line. The test is five minutes. Thank you.

extra_audio.text: The visitor arrives at the entrance of the plant. He takes a safety card and safety glasses. He goes to the first floor for the meeting. After the meeting he visits the production area. He stays outside the yellow line, next to the machines.

reading.rtitle: Before You Visit -- The Robertet Plant
paras: Welcome to the Robertet plant in Brazil. There is one entrance for visitors. It is next to the parking area, on the right.
There are two floors. The offices are on the first floor. The production area is on the ground floor, next to the warehouse.
In the production area there are eight machines and four tanks. The tanks are behind the machines. There is a yellow safety line on the floor. Please stay outside the line.
There is no food and no drink in the production area. The safety glasses are in a box at the entrance. There is a safety meeting every Monday, at eight in the morning.
